decisions.reason: Kaspersky-reporting on Operation ShadowCloud, two previously undocumented Windows backdoors (GraphDoor via SharePoint, GitDoor via GitHub) used against government networks in Asia and Africa.
Substantive research on TheMailer phishing kit: multiple commercial AI models and an Inbox Loop that rewrites spam-flagged lures using delivery feedback.
Supply-chain compromise of Microsoft agent-framework PyPI versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 with a credential stealer aimed at cloud identities and CI/CD secrets; corroborates the existing story.
Additional Hacker News coverage of Java4Shell / CVE-2026-114938, pre-auth RCE affecting Java 17.0.6+ on AVX-512 VBMI x86-64 hosts, already tracked as Java2Shell.
